title: Tamsin and the Inheritance
author: Lena Crane
blurb: Quentin Okonkwo, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
